```{r  Samples}
biomarkers <- read_csv("enriched_features_level1.csv")
#biomarkers <- read_csv("biomarkers_level5_triplicates.csv")
Lib_search <- read_tsv("MSV93005_library_matches.tsv")
metadata <- read_csv("Patterson_metadata.csv")
Lib_search <- Lib_search[,c("#Scan#", "Node")]
colnames(biomarkers)[colnames(biomarkers) == "Feature"] <- "Node"
Biomarker_hits <- Lib_search %>% left_join(biomarkers, by = "Node")

Sample_featuretable <- read_csv("Patterson_Beef_ConjBA_iimn_quant.csv")

#data_transpose
Sample_transpose <- Sample_featuretable %>% 
  column_to_rownames("row ID") %>% 
  dplyr::select(contains(".mzML")) %>% 
  t() %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("filename")


#remove Peak area from filename from feature table
Sample_transpose$filename <- gsub(" Peak area", "", Sample_transpose$filename)
Sample_transpose <- Sample_transpose %>% arrange(filename)

#TIC normalisation
# Set the row names using the 'filename' column
Sample_tic <- column_to_rownames(Sample_transpose, var = "filename")
Sample_tic <- Sample_tic + 1
Sample_tic <- sweep(Sample_tic, 1, rowSums(Sample_tic), FUN = "/")
Sample_tic <- Sample_tic * 1e5
Sample_tic <- as.data.frame(Sample_tic)
Sample_tic <- t(Sample_tic) %>% as.data.frame()

# Bring row names into a column called "row ID"
Sample_tic <- Sample_tic %>% rownames_to_column("row ID")

Biomarkers_in_samples <- Sample_tic %>%
  filter(`row ID` %in% Lib_search$`#Scan#`)

Biomarkers_in_samples <- Biomarkers_in_samples %>% 
  column_to_rownames("row ID") %>% 
  dplyr::select(contains(".mzML")) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("#Scan#")

Biomarker_hits$`#Scan#` <- as.character(Biomarker_hits$`#Scan#`)
Biomarkers_in_samples <- Biomarkers_in_samples %>% left_join(Biomarker_hits, by = "#Scan#" )
Biomarkers_in_samples <- Biomarkers_in_samples %>% na.omit(Biomarkers_in_samples$category)
df_foods <- Biomarkers_in_samples %>%
  separate_rows(category, sep = ", ") 

food_summarized <- df_foods %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(across(contains("mzmL"), sum, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

food_summarized <- food_summarized %>%
  column_to_rownames("category") 
food_summarized <- food_summarized %>% t() %>% as.data.frame()
food_summarized <- food_summarized %>% rownames_to_column("filename")

food_summarized$filename <- gsub(" Peak area", "", food_summarized$filename)

food_summarized <- bind_cols(
  filename = food_summarized[[1]],
  food_summarized %>% 
    dplyr::select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(),
      ~ {
        min_val <- min(., na.rm = TRUE)
        max_val <- max(., na.rm = TRUE)
        if (max_val == min_val) {
          rep(50, length(.))
        } else {
          ((. - min_val) / (max_val - min_val)) * 100
        }
      }
    ))
)

food_metadata <- food_summarized %>% left_join(metadata, by = "filename")
  
food_metadata <- food_metadata %>%
  filter(str_detect(PERIOD, "DP|BL")) %>%
  filter(str_detect(PERIOD, "DP|BL"))

#write.csv(food_metadata, "MEDDiet_level3.csv", row.names = FALSE)

food_metadata$TREAT <- factor(food_metadata$TREAT, levels = c("baseline", "MED0.5", "MED2.5", "MED5.5", "AAD"))

# Define comparisons explicitly using character format
comparisons_list <- list(
  c("baseline", "MED0.5"),
  c("baseline", "MED2.5"),
  c("baseline", "MED5.5"),

# Create the plot
bar_plot <- ggplot(food_metadata, aes(x = TREAT, y =animal, fill = TREAT)) +
```

```{r Volcano}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# Get numeric variables (excluding ID columns)
numeric_vars <- names(food_metadata)[sapply(food_metadata, is.numeric)]
numeric_vars <- numeric_vars[!grepl("ID|id", numeric_vars, ignore.case = TRUE)]

# Define baseline and treatment group for comparison
baseline_group <- "baseline"
treatment_group <- "MED5.5"  # Change this to compare different groups

# Calculate statistics for volcano plot
volcano_data <- data.frame()

for (var in numeric_vars) {
  # Get data for baseline and treatment
  baseline_values <- food_metadata[food_metadata$TREAT == baseline_group, var]
  treatment_values <- food_metadata[food_metadata$TREAT == treatment_group, var]
  
  # Remove NA values
  baseline_values <- baseline_values[!is.na(baseline_values)]
  treatment_values <- treatment_values[!is.na(treatment_values)]
  
  # Skip if not enough data
  if (length(baseline_values) < 2 || length(treatment_values) < 2) next
  
  # Calculate fold change (log2)
  mean_baseline <- mean(baseline_values)
  mean_treatment <- mean(treatment_values)
  fold_change <- log2(mean_treatment / mean_baseline)
  
  # Perform t-test
  t_test <- t.test(treatment_values, baseline_values)
  p_value <- t_test$p.value
  
  # Store results
  volcano_data <- rbind(volcano_data, data.frame(
    Variable = var,
    log2FC = fold_change,
    pvalue = p_value,
    neg_log10_pvalue = -log10(p_value),
    mean_baseline = mean_baseline,
    mean_treatment = mean_treatment
  ))
}

# Add significance categories
volcano_data$significance <- "Not Significant"
volcano_data$significance[volcano_data$pvalue < 0.05 & volcano_data$log2FC > 0.5] <- "Up-regulated"
volcano_data$significance[volcano_data$pvalue < 0.05 & volcano_data$log2FC < -0.5] <- "Down-regulated"
volcano_data$significance[volcano_data$pvalue < 0.05 & abs(volcano_data$log2FC) <= 0.5] <- "Significant"

# Create volcano plot
volcano_plot <- ggplot(volcano_data, aes(x = log2FC, y = neg_log10_pvalue, color = significance)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.95) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "red", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.5, 0.5), linetype = "dashed", color = "blue", alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Up-regulated" = "#A2D17D", 
                               "Down-regulated" = "#A75252", 
                               "Significant" = "orange",
                               "Not Significant" = "gray")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10)
  ) +
  labs(title = paste("Volcano Plot:", treatment_group, "vs", baseline_group),
       x = "Log2 Fold Change",
       y = "-Log10 p-value",
       color = "Significance") +
  geom_text_repel(data = volcano_data[volcano_data$pvalue < 0.05, ], 
                  aes(label = Variable), 
                  size = 3, 
                  box.padding = 0.3,
                  point.padding = 0.3)

print(volcano_plot)

#ggsave("Volcano_plot_baselinevsMED5.5.svg", plot = volcano_plot, dpi = 300, width = 8, height = 6)

# Print summary table
cat("Summary of significant variables:\n")
significant_vars <- volcano_data[volcano_data$pvalue < 0.05, ]
if(nrow(significant_vars) > 0) {
  print(significant_vars[order(significant_vars$pvalue), c("Variable", "log2FC", "pvalue", "significance")])
} else {
  cat("No significant variables found.\n")
}

```

```{r S-plot}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# Get numeric variables (excluding ID columns)
numeric_vars <- names(food_metadata)[sapply(food_metadata, is.numeric)]
numeric_vars <- numeric_vars[!grepl("ID|id", numeric_vars, ignore.case = TRUE)]

# Define baseline and treatment group for comparison
baseline_group <- "baseline"
treatment_group <- "MED5.5"  # Change this to compare different groups

# Calculate statistics for S-plot
splot_data <- data.frame()

for (var in numeric_vars) {
  # Get data for baseline and treatment
  baseline_values <- food_metadata[food_metadata$TREAT == baseline_group, var]
  treatment_values <- food_metadata[food_metadata$TREAT == treatment_group, var]
  
  # Remove NA values
  baseline_values <- baseline_values[!is.na(baseline_values)]
  treatment_values <- treatment_values[!is.na(treatment_values)]
  
  # Skip if not enough data
  if (length(baseline_values) < 2 || length(treatment_values) < 2) next
  
  # Calculate means
  mean_baseline <- mean(baseline_values)
  mean_treatment <- mean(treatment_values)
  
  # Calculate covariance and correlation
  combined_values <- c(baseline_values, treatment_values)
  group_indicator <- c(rep(0, length(baseline_values)), rep(1, length(treatment_values)))
  
  # Calculate covariance between variable and group
  covariance <- cov(combined_values, group_indicator)
  
  # Calculate correlation between variable and group
  correlation <- cor(combined_values, group_indicator)
  
  # Alternative calculation: effect size and reliability
  pooled_sd <- sqrt(((length(baseline_values) - 1) * var(baseline_values) + 
                     (length(treatment_values) - 1) * var(treatment_values)) / 
                    (length(baseline_values) + length(treatment_values) - 2))
  
  # Calculate p(1) - contribution to discrimination
  p1 <- abs(mean_treatment - mean_baseline) / pooled_sd
  
  # Calculate p(corr) - reliability/correlation
  p_corr <- abs(correlation)
  
  # Perform t-test for significance
  t_test <- t.test(treatment_values, baseline_values)
  p_value <- t_test$p.value
  
  # Store results
  splot_data <- rbind(splot_data, data.frame(
    Variable = var,
    p1 = p1,
    p_corr = p_corr,
    covariance = covariance,
    correlation = correlation,
    pvalue = p_value,
    mean_baseline = mean_baseline,
    mean_treatment = mean_treatment,
    fold_change = mean_treatment / mean_baseline
  ))
}

# Add significance categories
splot_data$significance <- "Not Significant"
splot_data$significance[splot_data$pvalue < 0.05 & splot_data$p1 > 0.5] <- "Significant & Reliable"
splot_data$significance[splot_data$pvalue < 0.05 & splot_data$p1 <= 0.5] <- "Significant"
splot_data$significance[splot_data$pvalue >= 0.05 & splot_data$p1 > 0.5] <- "Reliable"

# Filter for significant variables only
significant_splot_data <- splot_data[splot_data$pvalue < 0.05, ]

# Create bar plot for p1 (magnitude) - significant variables only
p1_barplot <- ggplot(significant_splot_data, aes(x = reorder(Variable, p1), y = p1, fill = significance)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Significant & Reliable" = "red", 
                              "Significant" = "orange",
                              "Reliable" = "blue")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10)
  ) +
  labs(title = paste("Magnitude of Change (p1) - Significant Variables:", treatment_group, "vs", baseline_group),
       x = "Variables",
       y = "p(1) - Magnitude of Change",
       fill = "Classification")

print(p1_barplot)

```


```{r PCA/PLSDA}
food_read <- food_summarized %>% filter(str_detect(filename, "BeefDiet")) %>% filter(!str_detect(filename, "Pool")) %>%arrange(filename)
metadata <- metadata %>% arrange(filename) %>% filter(filename %in% food_read$filename)

PCA_whole <- mixOmics::pca(food_read, ncomp = 4, scale = TRUE)
PCA_whole_scores <- data.frame(PCA_whole$variates$X, metadata)
PCA_plot <- PCA_whole_scores %>%
  ggscatter(x = "PC1", y = "PC2", color = "TREAT", alpha = 0.9, size = 4.5,
            title = paste("PCA", "MED diet food readout", sep = " "),
            xlab = paste("PC1 (", round(PCA_whole$prop_expl_var$X[1]*100, digits = 2),"%)", sep = ""), 
            ylab = paste("PC2 (", round(PCA_whole$prop_expl_var$X[2]*100, digits = 2),"%)", sep = ""),
            ggtheme = theme_bw()) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(colour = TREAT), alpha = 1) + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 20, colour = "black"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 20),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", size = 1.5)) +
  coord_fixed()

print(PCA_plot)

#ggsave("PCA_MED_diet_food_readout.svg", plot = PCA_plot, dpi = 300, width = 8, height = 6)

# Assign sample_type_group3 to a separate variable
sample_group <- PCA_whole_scores$TREAT

# Ensure the grouping variable is a factor
PCA_whole_scores$TREAT <- as.factor(sample_group)
filter_data <- food_read %>% 
  column_to_rownames("filename") %>% 
  dplyr::select(where(is.numeric))

# PLS-DA
PLSDA_whole <- mixOmics::plsda(filter_data, sample_group, ncomp = 5, scale = TRUE)
PLSDA_whole_scores <- data.frame(PLSDA_whole$variates$X) %>% 
  rownames_to_column("filename") 
PLSDA_whole_scores$filename <- trimws(PLSDA_whole_scores$filename)
PLSDA_whole_scores <- PLSDA_whole_scores %>%
  left_join(metadata, by = "filename")


# Add sample_group as a column to PLSDA_whole_scores
PLSDA_whole_scores$sample_group <- sample_group

# PLSDA plot
PLSDA_incubation_time <- PLSDA_whole_scores %>%
  ggscatter(
    x = "comp1", y = "comp2", color = "sample_group", alpha = 0.8, 
    title = "PLSDA_Stool - visit_code",
    xlab = paste("Component 1 (", round(PLSDA_whole$prop_expl_var$X[1] * 100, digits = 1), "%)", sep = ""), 
    ylab = paste("Component 2 (", round(PLSDA_whole$prop_expl_var$X[2] * 100, digits = 1), "%)", sep = ""),
    legend.title = "Group", ggtheme = theme_bw()
  ) +
  stat_ellipse(
    aes(color = sample_group),
    alpha = 0.8,   # Adjust transparency of the ellipse
    type = "t"     # Type "t" fits the ellipse to a t-distribution
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = PLSDA_whole_scores %>% 
      group_by(sample_group) %>% 
      summarise(across(matches("comp"), mean)),  # Calculate mean PC1 and PC2
    aes(comp1, comp2, color = sample_group), 
    size = 4, 
    shape = 8  # Star-shaped marker for centroids
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, colour = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", size = 1.5)  # Adjust border color and thickness here
  ) + 
  coord_fixed()

print(PLSDA_incubation_time)
# First, check how many unique groups you have
table(metadata$TREAT)

# Then provide enough colors (assuming you have 5 groups)
biplot(PLSDA_whole, 
       comp = c(1,2), 
       col.per.group = c("blue", "red", "green", "orange", "purple"), 
       group = metadata$TREAT, 
       legend = TRUE, 
       pch = 19, 
       cex = 2, 
       var.label = TRUE, 
       var.cex = 0.9,
       cutoff = 0.01,
       max.overlaps = Inf,
       ind.names = FALSE,  # This removes individual sample labels
       title = "PLS-DA Biplot - MED Diet Food Readout")
```

```{r Bileacids}

Bileacids <- read_csv("MassQL_bileacids.csv")
Bileacids <- Bileacids %>% filter(!str_detect(query_validation, "Did not pass"))
Bileacids$`#Scan#` <- as.character(Bileacids$`#Scan#`)
bile_cols <- Bileacids$`#Scan#`

Sample_bileacids <- Sample_tic %>% filter(`row ID` %in% bile_cols)

Sample_bileacids <- Sample_bileacids %>% 
  column_to_rownames("row ID") %>% 
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("filename")

Sample_bileacids <- Sample_bileacids %>% filter(filename %in% food_metadata$filename)
Sample_bile_food <- Sample_bileacids %>% left_join(food_metadata, by = "filename")
foods <- colnames(food_summarized)[-1]  # Exclude the filename column

combined_data <- Sample_bile_food %>%
  left_join(food_summarized, by = "filename")

print(paste("Using", length(bile_cols), "bile acid columns (scan numbers)"))

# Food columns are from the foods vector (from food_summarized)
food_cols <- foods
print(paste("Using", length(food_cols), "food columns"))

# For correlation, we'll use Sample_bile_food for bile acids and food_summarized for foods
# Both should be merged by filename already in your workflow

# Create the analysis datasets
bile_data <- Sample_bile_food[, bile_cols, drop = FALSE]
food_data <- food_summarized[, food_cols, drop = FALSE]

# Make sure we have matching samples (same filenames)
common_files <- intersect(Sample_bile_food$filename, food_summarized$filename)
print(paste("Found", length(common_files), "common samples between bile and food data"))

# Filter both datasets to common samples and align them
bile_subset <- Sample_bile_food[Sample_bile_food$filename %in% common_files, ]
food_subset <- food_summarized[food_summarized$filename %in% common_files, ]

# Order both datasets by filename to ensure alignment
bile_subset <- bile_subset[order(bile_subset$filename), ]
food_subset <- food_subset[order(food_subset$filename), ]

# Extract the data matrices
bile_data <- bile_subset[, bile_cols, drop = FALSE]
food_data <- food_subset[, food_cols, drop = FALSE]

print(paste("Final dataset dimensions:"))
print(paste("Bile acids:", nrow(bile_data), "samples x", ncol(bile_data), "bile acids"))
print(paste("Foods:", nrow(food_data), "samples x", ncol(food_data), "foods"))
food_data <- food_subset[, food_cols, drop = FALSE]

# Convert to numeric matrices (in case there are any character columns)
bile_matrix <- as.matrix(sapply(bile_data, as.numeric))
food_matrix <- as.matrix(sapply(food_data, as.numeric))

# Calculate Pearson correlations between all bile acids and all foods
correlation_matrix <- cor(bile_matrix, food_matrix, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

# Convert to data frame for easier manipulation
correlation_df <- as.data.frame(correlation_matrix)
correlation_df$bile_acid <- rownames(correlation_df)

# Reshape to long format for analysis and visualization
correlation_long <- correlation_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -bile_acid, 
               names_to = "food", 
               values_to = "correlation")

# Remove any NA correlations
correlation_long <- correlation_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(correlation))

# View summary of correlations
print("Summary of correlation coefficients:")
summary(correlation_long$correlation)

# Find strongest positive and negative correlations
print("\nTop 10 strongest positive correlations:")
correlation_long %>%
  arrange(desc(correlation)) %>%
  head(10) %>%
  print()

print("\nTop 10 strongest negative correlations:")
correlation_long %>%
  arrange(correlation) %>%
  head(10) %>%
  print()

# Create a heatmap of correlations
# Note: This might be large if you have many bile acids and foods
# You may want to filter to show only significant correlations

# Filter for correlations with absolute value > 0.3 (adjust threshold as needed)
significant_correlations <- correlation_long %>%
  filter(abs(correlation) > 0.3)

Bileacids$`#Scan#` <- as.character(Bileacids$`#Scan#`)

significant_correlations <- significant_correlations %>% left_join(Bileacids, by= c("bile_acid" = "#Scan#"))

library(pheatmap)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

if(nrow(significant_correlations) > 0) {
  # Convert to wide format matrix for pheatmap
  # Handle duplicates by taking the mean correlation
  corr_matrix <- significant_correlations %>%
    dplyr::select(food, Compound_Name, correlation) %>%
    group_by(food, Compound_Name) %>%
    summarise(correlation = mean(correlation, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = food, values_from = correlation, values_fill = 0) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Compound_Name") %>%
    as.matrix()
  
  # Create the heatmap with pheatmap
  p1 <- pheatmap(corr_matrix,
                 color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100),
                 breaks = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 101),
                 cluster_rows = TRUE,
                 cluster_cols = TRUE,
                 scale = "none",
                 main = "Bile Acids vs Foods Correlation Heatmap\nShowing correlations with |r| > 0.3",
                 fontsize = 10,
                 fontsize_row = 10,
                 fontsize_col = 10,
                 angle_col = 45,
                 cellwidth = 10,
                 cellheight = 10,
                 border_color = "grey60",
                 na_col = "grey90")
  
  print(p1)
} else {
  print("No correlations with absolute value > 0.3 found")
}

#ggsave("Bile_acids_foods_correlation_heatmap.svg", plot = p1, dpi = 300, width = 18, height = 10)
```
